questions.solution:
When nitric acid is left for long standing, its color changes due to decomposition reaction.
The reaction in which one reactant yields two or more products, it is called a decomposition reaction. Due to decomposition, concentrated nitric acid (HNO3) gets broken down to nitrogen dioxide, oxygen, and water. Due to the formation of nitrogen dioxide, it turns yellow-brown. The chemical reaction involved in the reaction is as follows:
4  HNO 3 →4  NO 2  +  O 2  + 2  H 2 O
